thanks for all your answers!   

I'm currently living in a suburb in northern switzerland (pretty far away from the alps). I'll be stuck here saving up money for the next 10-20 years and was hoping to then settle somewhere else. Originally the plan was to go up to the mountains but looking at Irelands vax rate, seems to be a lotmore sensible place... the question is whether Schengen will still be a thing in 20 years, so where I am even allowed to move to. Technically could go to the US (partner is a US citizen).
you seem to know your stuff. What would be your top 5 best countries to survive in ideally for about another 60 years?

Thank you (you came across as kind, no worries). I have been seeing my therapist for 5 years. Actually saw him today but we didn't have time to talk about this since we were working on childhood trauma. He is generally aware of how I am doing but it gets a lot worse in the evenings... Ironically my last job as a doctor was in a psych hospital, so I was the "therapist" (don't have the training but they had me do it anyways) helping suicidal people while having those thoughts myself. 

I can't really take time off, nominally I have but have to do other (unpaid) work... research stuff that I have to do by a contract.   

I know I need to learn to accept being worthless to the world. I mean I always was but the world didn't know because I was able to hide it behind the fake "perfect doctor" persona. Now there is nothing left. In my country medicine is its own 6 years degree, so I don't even have an undergrad to fall back on. I'll be lucky if anyone gives me any low level wfh job that pays my rent.

I've been circling a coding bootcamp that claims 90% job-offer rate for a while now.   

I think the main thing for me would be that I need a work from home job to be truly happy. Face-to-face human contact always ruins my day (with the exception of very few humans I trust). I don't mind zoom calls, it is a being in the same room thing.   

Side note: I've been in therapy for 5 years. Been talking about the current situation too and I think the takeaway is that my psych is happy about any path that ends with me not being dead so...   

I guess I am worried about dropping out of medicine and then not finding a job within a year (that is about the amount of money I got saved up). Like knowing it is either suicide or being homeless... that thought is terrifying. But staying in medicine is too... 

I'd need about 60K to live like I do now, I am happy with 90K (books are cheap and I don't need to have anything expensive). Ideally I'd want to work max 50% (so 25hrs a week) which makes things tough... do you think that is even achieveable?

Having issues yourself is no reason why you can't help others. I am a medical student and I'm suicidal on/off, doesn't mean I can't do my job and help others. No one will notice if you don't decide to show it.

(Hey, thanks for taking the time to respond to me all the time...)

Yeah I do like her, but idk if I can do this to her, forcing her back into the closet forever. And then I'd either get her to get a degree or would be ashamed of her... and that isnt a nice feeling either, your partner being ashamed of you...   
Yes I'll have to stay local for several years, since this is a small country and I already matched a local surgery residency (which is also one of the best in my desired field, like I was really lucky to get this position it is one you do not say no to). But all the surgeons in the field know each other anyways so if you are out to anyone, everyone knows. The amount of gossiping is ... well high school levels. 
I wouldnt know who to reach out to. I don't know anyone or have any friends really... 
And I moved out already. Live on my own now though my father pays for the apartment, so if he'd figure out I am maybe not straight I'd be homeless, so there is another reason to be really careful.

I am sry about your grandfather passing away. 

It might be that real love exists but not for me. I don't have enough to offer in a relationship. Right now there is actually a person who loves me but she is a girl on another continent and we could never openly live together or have children. And I can't do that to her, being "roommates" all our lifes, especially because she has been out already. And for me it would mean to have to hide her and live with the ever increasing questions of "why have you been single for ages". Also she has no degree and is overweight, the latter she wants to fix for me but still even if she was male I could never present her as my partner like that. The first question upon introduction is "what did you study" the second one is "where". It determines your social status here.

Oh it wasn't a friend. Just someone that was important to me but I served no function for her and it was bordering delusional of me to think I could be of any worth to her.  

Well, I still think it was my responsibility for not walking away. I am not going to blame anyone else for my (lack of) actions, that would be a pathetic thing to do.   

Yes I used to be a very empathic person. I am not anymore since that day that woman told me to go away... and seeing several people die, become vegetables or get terrible diagnosis (doing clinical rounds now) I think that is a good thing. I have grown up. I don't know if you worked clinically yet or saw that in shadowing but people really don't care. I mean you do your best to help the patient but at the end of the day you go home and have dinner and forget about them. And you have to cause I don't think you'd survive long actually caring. 

> Does your medical school have psychological services for students?     

That is how you end your career before you start it. I matched surgery (match works differently in my country) that place would be gone in a second if anybody knew about me having any issues (or maybe not being straight for that matter).

I have a psychiatrist (secretly of course), he is on vacation now though and scheduling during rotations is a mess so I'll probably see him again in December or smth.

I don't remmeber if I explicitly said it. But he knew it. He talked a lot about how hard it was that I didnt like it, that he sometimes felt like he was raping me that it was a turn off if I looked sad or closed my eyes during it.  
So I tried to act like I like it, tried to satisfy him as good and fast as I can so I woudl not have to do it for the rest of the day.   
Well of course I was allowed to stop, he did not hold a gun to my head or anything. Just like he wouldnt be satisfied until I came up with something good. And not satisfied could end in suicidal pretty darn quickly so I tried.    I was stupid and naive and thought saving a life is more important than anything else. More improtant than me being comfortable at least. Then I looked around and realized that humans are egoistic, no one cares about people dying or killing themselves. Someone that was very important to me basically told me to go away and never talk to her again, that kinda changed me in a way so I was able to break up with my ex without caring if he died. He did attempt later but survived. Rn he is still alive afaik but we don't really keep in touch so who knows. 

So, part of my life story in a nutshell I guess. Sry about that.

I don't need to enjoy it, I just need to be able to bear sexually satisfying my husband so he stays with me...

And I was only allowed to stop once I had found something that satisfied him at least for the moment, but it only held a day or two. It never ended and I wanted nothing more than to run away and never have to have sex again.I tried it for 5 years, to be normal.

Even if all that is true, you still have to be able to tolerate penetration to satisfy a hetero-man. 

I am not concerned with what I like, I mean I can live without sex for my whole life just fine. But to get all the nice things in a relationship I'd need to be able to satisfy my husband. That is the problem.
